entries.en: Fixed VS Code extension failing to activate on Windows due to a hardcoded build path in the bundled SDK (`createRequire` polyfill bug)
entries.zh: 修复了由于捆绑 SDK 中的硬编码构建路径而导致 VS Code 扩展无法在 Windows 上激活的问题（`createRequire`polyfill 错误）

entries.en: Fixed Mantle endpoint authentication failing with missing `x-api-key` header
entries.zh: 修复了 Mantle 端点身份验证因缺少`x-api-key`标头而失败的问题
